name: product_catalog
description: Product catalog of an online outdoor & sports equipment retailer. Each record is one product with its variants.
context: Brands are fictional. Prices follow a long tail: many accessories under EUR 30, core gear EUR 60-300, a few premium items (tents, bikes, GPS watches) up to several thousand. Dimensions and weights must be physically plausible for the product type (a tent packs to ~50x20x20 cm and 2-4 kg; a water bottle is under 1 kg). Materials are real (ripstop nylon, merino wool, 6061 aluminium, EVA foam). Ratings skew positive; new products have few or no reviews.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Product name including brand line and key attribute (e.g. 'Kestrel 2P Ultralight Tent').

fields.name: description
fields.description: Marketing description with concrete specs and use cases.

fields.name: variants
fields.description: Purchasable variants (color/size combinations) with stock levels.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Average rating; null when the product has no reviews.

rules: Price, materials, dimensions and weight must be plausible for the specific product.
Apparel variants use sizes XS-XXL; footwear uses EU sizes; equipment usually 'one size' or model sizes.
checks: len({(v['color'].lower(), v['size'].lower()) for v in variants}) == len(variants)
